title: Intermediate mesoderm

objective.text: Describe how intermediate mesoderm is laid out along the body and what it builds.

body.general: Which strip of tissue builds the kidneys? It is intermediate mesoderm, a thin strip of middle-layer tissue between two wider strips [f5]. It builds the urinary and genital organs [f1]. In the neck and upper chest it breaks into small repeating clusters, the nephrotomes [f2]. Lower down it stays one continuous cord, the nephrogenic cord [f3]. From these come the kidney's urine-making units and the sex glands, or gonads [f4]. The bladder's inner lining is different: it comes from endoderm, the inner germ layer [f6].
body.mbbs: Intermediate mesoderm is the narrow strip between paraxial mesoderm and the lateral plate [f5]. It forms the urogenital system [f1]. In the cervical and upper thoracic regions it forms segmental cell clusters, the nephrotomes [f2]. More caudally it stays an unsegmented mass, the nephrogenic cord [f3]. These give rise to the excretory units of the urinary system and to the gonads [f4]. Not every urogenital lining is mesoderm: the urinary bladder's lining comes from endoderm [f6].

facts.text: Intermediate mesoderm forms the urogenital system.
In the neck and upper chest it forms segmental clusters called nephrotomes.
Further down it stays an unsegmented strip, the nephrogenic cord.
It gives the excretory units of the kidney and the gonads.
Intermediate mesoderm lies between paraxial mesoderm and the lateral plate.
The lining of the urinary bladder comes from endoderm, not mesoderm.

misconceptions.wrong: The bladder is mesoderm like the rest of the urogenital system.
misconceptions.right: Its lining is endoderm, from the cloaca; kidneys, gonads and ducts are mesoderm.

checks.prompt: What does intermediate mesoderm form in the neck and upper chest?
checks.why: Up high it breaks into repeating nephrotomes; lower down it stays one continuous nephrogenic cord.

checks.prompt: Which of these comes from intermediate mesoderm?
checks.why: Intermediate mesoderm builds the urogenital system, including the gonads and the kidney's excretory units.

checks.prompt: Where does the lining of the urinary bladder come from?
checks.why: Kidneys and gonads are mesoderm, but the bladder lining is endoderm.

adult: This strip becomes the kidney's excretory units and the gonads [f4].

remember.a: The urogenital system: the kidney's excretory units and the gonads [f1,f4].

remember.q: How does intermediate mesoderm differ high versus low in the body?
remember.a: Repeating clusters (nephrotomes) in the neck and upper chest; one continuous nephrogenic cord below [f2,f3].
